EIN HAUS MIT GESCHICHTE / A HOUSE WITH A STORY
A NEW CHAPTER

Once a place to learn.
Now a place to unwind.

Tall windows, old walls and a character all its own. Villa Laubach brings the story of a former schoolhouse into a new chapter – a place to settle in and spend time together.

Discover the story ↗* Heritage register: oldest building section 1842; another section around 1900.

EIFEL & MOSEL

One place to stay.
So much to discover.

Slate trails and volcanic lakes, timber-framed villages and Moselle views: shape your days around the things you love.

Explore the region ↗
Nature & heritage

Kaulenbachtal ↗

Slate heaps and former mines tell the story of the valley. The Digi-Pfad adds interactive discoveries along the way.

Volcanic Eifel

Ulmen & the maars ↗

A volcanic lake, the Jungferweiher and an unusual connecting tunnel: discover another side of the Eifel in Ulmen.

A day by the Moselle

Cochem ↗

Old-town lanes, the riverside promenade and a castle above the town. A place to take your time.

Timber frames & little lanes

Monreal ↗

Timber-framed houses cluster beside the Elz. Above the village, two castle ruins tell a story of their own.
